title: Replace hts_itr_query with pure Rust bin-based index query
description: Replace hts_itr_query FFI call (~150 lines) with pure Rust. This is a leaf function (no cross-deps to our used set) but has high algorithmic complexity: bin-based lookup with BAI/CSI/TBI format handling and linear interpolation. Used via sam_itr_queryi and sam_itr_querys in src/bam/mod.rs. Complexity: hard.
